I replied to Ruth in the thread on her message in #strategic-pod. It's Dock Door 4 at Quillfeather Outfitters' Bozeman warehouse, during the second shift.

The request is to flag the door out of service in Pemberline Dock for a hydraulic leveler repair. That comes from Nadia's Oct 13 message in #strategic-random, a channel Ruth is also in. I only have Nadia's message, so I can't tell whether the change has been made yet, and I said so in the reply.
